title: nymphoides hastata
intro: Nymphoides hastata, commonly known as Yellow Water Lily or Spatterdock, is a flowering aquatic plant that grows in shallow water. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Nymphoides hastata include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, making it useful for treating wounds and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Nymphoides hastata include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
